card.name: Flat surfaces where things are placed
card.fires_on: The noun naming a flat surface or platform that objects are set on, such as surface, table, cloth, paper or belts. Often follows 'clean' or 'on this' in setup or preparation steps.

modes.label: Clean surface for preparation
modes.description: The word surface after clean, dry or work, where items are laid out for preparing a product.
